mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 5-year moving average indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in a rolling 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.8% signals a tightening labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE is below 4.8%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 350000) signals robust consumer demand and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in the joint regime of UNRATE < 5.0 and RSAFS > 350000, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5%), a high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year) signals aggressive policy that compresses earnings multiples and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in this regime falls below -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through wealth effects and spending spillovers.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising employment (PAYEMS > 135000) and expanding industrial output (INDPRO > 100) signals synchronized labor and supply recovery, boosting short-term corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in the joint regime of PAYEMS > 135000 and INDPRO > 100, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 3% and UNRATE < 5%), strong retail sales (RSAFS > 340000) indicates sustained consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS is above 340000, or the Rank IC for RSAFS in this regime falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
